gate_reports.title: Authoritative Render Live Backup
gate_reports.blocking_reason: Place render_live_snapshot.sqlite in data/ and run audit-render-live-snapshot.ts
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Without this, no evidence that Render state is auditable. Cutover cannot proceed safely.

gate_reports.title: Render State Forensic Audit
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: All delta rows categorized; zero RENDER_BEHIND tables; human sign-off on delta
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Uncategorized delta rows create unknown production state. Cannot safely ingest or cutover.

gate_reports.title: Catch-Up Ingestion Verification
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: Zero unmigrated delta rows in staging PG; idempotency pass 2 delta = +0
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Uncaught delta rows leave staging PG and production SQLite out of sync. Ingest failures become non-idempotent errors.

gate_reports.title: PostgreSQL Production Provisioning
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: SSL enforced; WAL enabled; pool min=20 max=100; dedicated production cluster
gate_reports.evidence_path: Render dashboard -> Environment -> Database URL config
gate_reports.blocking_reason: Confirm Render PostgreSQL cluster config and paste connection string to proceed
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Misconfigured PG pool (too few connections) causes pool starvation under canary load. Hard rollback to SQLite required.

gate_reports.title: Outbox Synchronization Zero-Lag
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Pending outbox events during cutover create write-path split-brain. Must be zero before any canary activation.

gate_reports.title: Render Runtime Disarm Benchmark
gate_reports.blocking_reason: No benchmark recorded. Run verify-phase-11-canary-router.ts on Render container.
gate_reports.rollback_impact: If disarm is slow on Render container (>10ms), live traffic experiences brief split-brain during emergency rollback window.

gate_reports.title: SQLite Standby Read-Path Readiness
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: 100% reads succeed via SQLite during simulated PG termination on Render
gate_reports.evidence_path: Must run fallback drill directly on Render container
gate_reports.blocking_reason: Cannot verify from local environment. Run disarm + SQLite-only traffic drill on Render.
gate_reports.rollback_impact: If SQLite fallback fails on Render (misconfigured path, permissions), there is NO safe fallback during canary incidents.

gate_reports.title: Deterministic Canary Router
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Without deterministic routing, users see inconsistent data between requests (session flickering).

gate_reports.title: Zero-Disruption SQLite Fallback
gate_reports.measured_value: 2 DISARM events in audit log; post_disarm_errors=0
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: 0 HTTP 500s; 0 dropped requests; instant SQLite restore on disarm
gate_reports.rollback_impact: If fallback is not instant, in-flight PG errors propagate to clients during rollback.

gate_reports.title: Decoupled Latency Profiling
gate_reports.measured_value: t_pool<10ms, t_query<15ms, t_http<100ms — all PASS in staging test
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: t_pool≤10ms; t_query P95≤3ms P99≤15ms; t_http P95 added delta≤5ms
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Without metric separation, a slow serializer masks a healthy DB — wrong rollback decisions made.

gate_reports.title: Render Runtime Disarm SLA
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: Disarm execution < 10ms on Render production container
gate_reports.blocking_reason: No benchmark recorded. Run verify-phase-11-canary-router.ts on Render container.
gate_reports.rollback_impact: If disarm is slow on Render container (>10ms), live traffic experiences brief split-brain during emergency rollback window.

gate_reports.title: Live Render Evidence Bundle Signed
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Unsigned bundle means no certified baseline for rollback comparison during production incidents.

gate_reports.title: Outbox Catch-Up Zero-Lag
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: pending=0 AND failed=0 AND dlq=0; replication_lag < 5s
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Outbox lag during canary means writes applied to PG without SQLite confirmation — data loss risk on hard rollback.

gate_reports.title: Security & Audit Logging
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: All routing decisions, disarms, fallbacks persisted; zero credentials in log
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Without audit trail, cannot forensically reconstruct what traffic was routed to PG during an incident.

gate_reports.title: Dry-Run Tier 1 + Tier 2 Rollback Drill
gate_reports.acceptance_threshold: Tier 1 disarm completes <10ms; Tier 2 full restore <15min; zero data corruption
gate_reports.blocking_reason: Execute rollback runbook on staging: (1) trigger disarm, (2) verify 100% SQLite routing, (3) restore backup, (4) verify outbox replay
gate_reports.rollback_impact: Without a verified drill, rollback procedure has unknown failure modes under production load.
